messages:
anika: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we captured remediation owners and timelines but we need to lock down ownership for the recurring span drops and the aggregation drift seen overnight. Who can own the ETL lag investigation?

mike: I can take ETL lag. Seen a similar surge two weeks ago. Will start with backlog analysis and look at the ingestion queue and upstream S3 errors.

luis: I will own aggregation correctness (suspect group-by bucketing mismatch). I found a suspicious change in the batch reducer from last quarter; will triage and add tests.

sara: Noted. Also noticed prod alerting was suppressed during the deploy window which let the gaps go unnoticed longer. I'll update the runbook to call this out and add an escalation step.

devops-bot: Created GH issue #4521 and linked the postmortem doc: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/4521 :spiral_note_pad:

jack: Quick question — can we add a scheduled smoke test that validates span coverage and aggregation totals post-deploy? Might catch regressions earlier. :+1:

anika: Proposed timelines: mike (ETL lag) — checkpoint Wed EOD; luis (aggregation) — PR by Fri EOD with unit tests; sara (runbook + alert config) — EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs to shift a timeline, ping me.

mike: Starting debug now. Pipeline backlog shows a surge between 03:12-03:45 UTC. Early signs point to S3 503/SlowDown errors causing retries and head-of-line blocking. Snippet from logs: 
```
2026-03-22T03:13:05Z ERROR s3 client: 503 SlowDown key=ingest/part-00012
2026-03-22T03:13:06Z WARN retrying operation (attempt=2)
```

luis: Ack. I'll add a regression unit test for the bucket edge case and run a local simulation against a scaled dataset. Will also review the reduce step that changed the bucket key.

sara: Runbook updates: add step to check S3 throttling metrics, temporary increase of consumer parallelism, and when to trigger manual backfill. I'll add the alert playbook with escalation matrix.

anika: Also proposing a recurring incident rotation owner — suggest the observability-rotation oncall owns aggregation/span correctness for the next 90 days unless a permanent owner is assigned. Thoughts?

jack: Fine by me. Also proposing a new metric: span_coverage_pct with alert if droppage >5% for 15m. We should surface that on the ops dashboard.

mike: Filing follow-ups: GH #4521 (backlog root cause), #4522 (s3 retry/backoff policy), #4523 (dashboard + alert), #4524 (runbook updates). Will link PRs and drop notes in the postmortem doc.

anika: Thanks everyone. I've scheduled a Wed 09:00 UTC checkpoint on calendars. Please update the GH issues with status before that checkpoint. Closing thread here — update the issues as you make progress and ping me if blockers pop up. :white_check_mark:
